item.title: Intent-Driven Development vs Spec-Driven Development: Compass and Map
item.description:
Intent-Driven Development vs Spec-Driven Development: Compass and Map Link to heading

The AI coding era exposed a gap that neither TDD nor BDD were designed to fill: who owns the “why” when the machine writes the “how”?

Two emerging methodologies answer this from different altitudes. Spec-Driven Development (SDD) treats specs as enforceable contracts — the map. Intent-Driven Development (IDD) treats intent as the durable source of truth above specs — the compass. They’re not competing. They’re complementary layers.

item.title: From "Wow It Works!" to "Wow It Still Works"
item.description:
From “Wow It Works!” to “Wow It Still Works” Link to heading

Making vibecoded apps production-worthy in five steps.

Vibecoding — term popularized by Andrej Karpathy (Feb 2025). Word of the Year 2025 — Collins Dictionary · Merriam-Webster trend.

There’s a dangerous moment in every AI-assisted project: the moment the demo works perfectly on localhost:8000 and the team declares “we’re done.” The button changes color. The data loads. Business sees a finished product. Engineering sees the beginning of the real work.

item.title: Silence Isn't a Barrier: My System for Redesigning Tech Leadership
item.description: My deafness forced me to treat communication like an engineering problem. The result is a system (documentation, async, interpreters) that not only works for me but makes teams faster and more efficient. True inclusion isn’t an accommodation; it’s a system upgrade for everyone.
